CDLI — Cuneiform Digital Library Initiative (Atra-ḫasīs / Flood tablets)

  • Site: https://cdli.earth (artifact pages https://cdli.earth/P######; catalogue JSON https://cdli.earth/artifacts/<id>/json; images https://cdli.earth/dl/photo/P######.jpg, …/dl/lineart/P######_l.jpg)
  • Retrieved: 2026-10-16
  • License: CDLI Terms of Use: images "are for the non-commercial use of students, scholars, and the public"; photographs are © the owning institutions (BM, Penn Museum, Yale/Morgan, MMA, Schøyen …). Catalogue metadata: freely reusable with citation (CDLI). Do not republish images without permission.

Important finding

CDLI has no transliterations (ATF) for any of these Atra-ḫasīs tablets — only catalogue data and (for some) photos / line art (hand copies). For text use SEAL, Wasserman 2020, and eBL.

Files

One sub-folder per artifact: P######.catalogue.json (raw CDLI catalogue export) + whatever images exist: P######.jpg photo, _d detail photo, _l line art (hand copy), _ld line-art detail.

Line numbering

n/a (no text). Use the museum numbers to match with Wasserman/SEAL sigla.

Assessment

Useful only for photos and hand copies to check readings (e.g. the CT 46 copies of the Sippar Flood tablet). Not a text source.
